part2.title: 文法連連看 (Matching)
part2.description: 共 5 組關卡，每組 4 題，請將左側題目與右側正確對應項目連線。

sets.setName: 關卡 1：附加問句配對 (Question Tags)

pairs.left: You're from Korea, ______?
Your sister likes animals very much, ______?
There are cookies in the box, ______?
Jill was excited at that party, ______?

sets.setName: 關卡 2：主動語態與被動語態配對 (Passive Voice)

pairs.left: People speak English all over the world.
pairs.right: English is spoken all over the world.

pairs.left: Ken and Lily drank milk this morning.
pairs.right: Milk was drunk by Ken and Lily this morning.

pairs.left: They close the museums on Mondays.
pairs.right: The museums are closed on Mondays.

pairs.left: Oscar rode my bike to school yesterday.
pairs.right: My bike was ridden to school by Oscar yesterday.

sets.setName: 關卡 3：現在完成式與 already / yet 配對

pairs.left: Zoe has ______ done her homework.
She hasn't studied for the English test ______.
Has Zoe read the new book ______?
Yes, she has ______ read the new book.

sets.setName: 關卡 4：完成進行式時間詞配對 (since / for)

pairs.left: Andy has been talking on the phone ______ 3:30.
Lucy has been watching TV ______ two hours.
I have been visiting Paris ______ last week.
Kate and Lily have been waiting for the bus ______ thirty minutes.

sets.setName: 關卡 5：關係代名詞與條件假設配對 (Relative & Conditional Clauses)

pairs.left: Do you see the woman ______ is standing at the door?
Who ate the cake ______ I made this morning?
What would you do if you ______ a lot of money?
If it is sunny tomorrow, they ______ swimming.
